programs.title: Summer Camp
programs.desc: As children, Ginny (Kathy Bates), Nora (Diane Keaton) and Mary (Alfre Woodard) spent every summer together.When, after 50 years, there is an opportunity to meet again - at a summer camp meeting, the friends decide to take advantage of it, although with varying levels of enthusiasm.The least satisfied with her holidays is workaholic Nora, who feels best in her own company.Despite this, she and her friends take on new challenges, such as rafting or a rope park.Additionally, there, the woman meets her former lover, Stevie D (Eugene Levy).Thanks to him and the camp atmosphere, things start to change.

programs.title: The Idea of You
programs.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway) is the owner of an art gallery.One day, a divorced woman accompanies her daughter to a concert and meets her musical idol - the singer of the boy band Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), about whom teenagers fantasize.Despite the significant age difference, they both feel that they have a lot in common.They start an affair.Paparazzi make their romantic moments miserable.The revelation of a young musician's relationship with a middle-aged single mother turns out to be a media sensation.An unusual love story with a script based on the novel by Robinne Lee.

programs.title: Barry 4
programs.desc: The last installment of the adventures of a paid killer who decided to change his life and tried his hand at acting.As a result of recent events, but primarily because of his criminal past, Barry (Bill Hader) goes to prison.His arrest was led by Gene Cousineau (Henry Winkler), an acting teacher who is now considered a hero by many.Barry's situation has a negative impact on his relationship with Sally (Sarah Goldberg).Gradually, the lonely and betrayed man breaks down and vows revenge.

programs.title: A Picture Of Her
programs.desc: Beth (Rhiannon Fish) works as first mate on a fishing vessel.He goes ashore for a while to take care of his aunt (Samantha Ferris), who has broken her leg.During her daily shopping, photographer Jake (Tyler Hynes) secretly takes a photo of her choosing flowers.A freelancer sends a photograph of a stranger to a newspaper under a pseudonym.Some time later, Beth and Jake meet in person.They both turn out to be dog lovers, and over time they discover that they have a lot in common.The lovers' relationship is getting closer.Then Beth's photo appears on the cover of a magazine and goes viral, making her very popular.The woman wants to find the author, meanwhile Jake does not have the courage to confess the truth.
